_comment: Names the site shows in place of the published ones (api/place_names.py). stops: a stop's name on boards, the map and search, by ATCO code; the published name is kept beside it, because coach headsigns are matched against it. coach_destinations: a coach's destination as a passenger says it (place) with the exact stop underneath (stop), keyed by the name as published: FlixBus's headsign whole, National Express's far end after ' - '. A plain place name (Brighton, Worthing, Gatwick Airport, Bristol) needs no entry. tests/test_place_names.py checks every coach destination in the timetable is either here or already plain; the weekly build warns when a new one appears. Added 6 November 2026 at the maintainer's request.
